statement: Allow fully automated progress inside a pre-authorized scope without asking for routine stage/merge confirmations or allowing an agent to approve itself.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: One explicit scoped grant can authorize the complete workflow and multiple eligible tasks without routine per-stage/per-task confirmation.
AC-02: Agents cannot expand scope, alter active host policy, approve their own role work or issue their own merge authority.
AC-03: Exact repo/PR/head authorization is generated and verified by the trusted boundary; stale/changed head, expiry/revocation and denied actions reject before effects.
AC-04: Budgets persist across restarts and apply to actual provider/command work; unsupported cost accounting fails or uses an explicit conservative limit.
AC-05: Policy/role/tool enforcement and allow/deny evidence are inspectable and secret-free.
AC-06: Manual mode and explicit human-only exception gates remain supported without pretending that a waiting run is complete.
AC-07: The configured GitHub permissions/protection prevent ordinary worker credentials from bypassing the controller or required checks; enforcement is verified.
